# Templates

[Documentation](../README.md) · [Components](../components/README.md)

| Template | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| [AppTemplate](./AppTemplate.md) | Responsive application shell with Sidebar and header composition |
| [FormTemplate](./FormTemplate.md) | Field/action grid; the application owns form semantics, validation and submission |

Both templates have six scoped recipes and a single Storybook story with local design
selection, inheriting the global system by default.
